oak.title: PROF. OAK
oak.line: Welcome to the world of Pokémon! Choose a partner to start your journey.
map.title: Kanto
map.locked: Master the route before to open this one.
map.gymSoon: Gym challenge coming in a later update

team.title: My Team
team.note: Your team plays vs Computer and online, where your friend sees it. Pick any Pokémon you have caught for each piece.
story.oak.1: OAK: Ah, there you are! I study Pokémon, and these days I study chess too.
story.oak.2: OAK: Every battle out there is won on a chessboard. Think a move ahead and your partner will trust you.
story.oak.3: OAK: But first, tell me who you are. Then pick a partner from my lab table.
story.oak.starter: OAK: {starter} likes you already. Head north to ROUTE 1 when you're ready.
story.oak.name: OAK: What is your name?
story.viridian.1: A shopkeeper waves: "Trainers on ROUTE 1 talking about you already? Not bad for day one."
story.viridian.2: Somebody is waiting at the edge of town, arms folded. You know that face.
story.rival1.1: BLUE: Took you long enough! Gramps gave me first pick of the lab, remember?
story.rival1.2: BLUE: Let's see if you can read a board better than you read a map!
story.rival2.1: BLUE: Hey! Still slow, still here. I already beat the gym in PEWTER, you know.
story.rival2.2: BLUE: I learned a few new tricks. Try to keep up!
story.rival3.1: BLUE: So you made it this far. The road to the LEAGUE starts right behind me.
story.rival3.2: BLUE: No more warm ups. Give me everything you've learned!
story.route.cleared: Every trainer on {route} is beaten. The path ahead is open!
trainer.lost: {class} {name} won this time. Try again with fresh puzzles!
line.r1-toby: Aw, my RATTATA tried its best. You found that mate fast!
line.r1-mina: You checked my king before I even blinked!
line.rival-1: BLUE: What? I picked the strong one! ...Fine. Next time it's mine.
line.vf-oskar: The forest is full of traps. Guess I walked into mine.
line.vf-liam: My bugs were ready. I wasn't.
line.vf-pip: Wow, you defend like a METAPOD hardens!
line.r3-dev: I left a piece hanging, didn't I? I always do that.
line.r3-rosa: My JIGGLYPUFF wanted to sing. You didn't give it a chance!
line.rival-2: BLUE: Hmph. Lucky board. I'm going to train twice as hard.
line.r6-kai: One knight, two targets. I should have seen it.
line.r6-noor: My picnic, my rules, your win.
line.r7-ines: That little pawn walked all the way and became a queen? Unfair. Brilliant, but unfair.
line.r7-theo: Next time I'm pushing my pawns first.
line.r14-sasha: Pinned like a bird on a branch.
line.r14-omar: My piece couldn't move without losing the king. Rough.
line.r8-june: The attack came out of nowhere!
line.r8-hugo: I bet on the wrong piece. Again.
line.r8-ada: Double check! I calculated everything except that.
line.r21-mo: I fished for a defender and you took it.
line.r21-lena: Swam right into your back rank trap.
line.r22-jun: You'll do fine at the LEAGUE. Probably.
line.r22-vera: Every theme, every trick. You've earned the road ahead.
line.rival-3: BLUE: ...Okay. You're good. Don't let it go to your head.

card.name: NAME: {name}
card.levelNote: The level is your Trainer Rating from puzzles: an estimate, not an official chess rating.
training.title: Training
training.note: Replay any theme from a route you have visited. Your Trainer Level still moves.
training.none: Visit a route first, then its themes appear here.
dex.title: POKÉDEX
dex.oak: Send a duplicate to OAK (+1 candy)
dex.sent: OAK: Thanks! Here's a candy for your {name}.
source.wild: tall grass and other wild spots
team.why.king: Kings: your starter's family only. It's your partner, the one you protect.
team.why.queenLocked: The queen opens after your first badge.
team.why.queen: Queens: fully evolved Pokémon or legendaries.
team.why.minor: Rooks, knights and bishops: evolved or single stage Pokémon, no legendaries.
team.why.pawn: Pawns must be first stage Pokémon. All 8 pawns are the same one.
team.notice: New team rules! These went back to the default piece: {list}.
lesson.mateIn1.title: CHECKMATE IN 1
lesson.mateIn1.goal: Find the one move that checkmates the king.
lesson.mateIn2.title: CHECKMATE IN 2
lesson.mateIn2.goal: Find a move that leads to checkmate on your next turn.
lesson.castling.title: CASTLING
lesson.castling.goal: Tuck your king safely behind a rook.
lesson.castling.banner: use castling to keep your king safe
lesson.hangingPiece.title: HANGING PIECES
lesson.hangingPiece.goal: Spot a piece nobody is guarding and take it.
lesson.trappedPiece.title: TRAPPED PIECES
lesson.trappedPiece.goal: Catch a piece that has no safe square left.
lesson.trappedPiece.banner: trap a piece that can't escape
lesson.advantage.title: WIN MATERIAL
lesson.advantage.goal: Find the move that wins a piece or more.
lesson.fork.title: FORKS
lesson.fork.goal: Find one move that attacks two pieces at once.
lesson.promotion.title: PROMOTION
lesson.promotion.goal: Walk a pawn to the last row and make it a queen.
lesson.advancedPawn.title: PASSED PAWNS
lesson.advancedPawn.goal: Push the pawn that nothing can stop.
lesson.pin.title: PINS
lesson.pin.goal: Freeze a piece so it can't move without losing something bigger.
lesson.discoveredAttack.title: DISCOVERED ATTACKS
lesson.discoveredAttack.goal: Move one piece out of the way so the one behind it attacks.
lesson.discoveredCheck.title: DISCOVERED CHECK
lesson.discoveredCheck.goal: Move a piece and let the one behind it give check.
lesson.doubleCheck.title: DOUBLE CHECK
lesson.doubleCheck.goal: Check the king with two pieces at once. Only the king can move!
lesson.capturingDefender.title: REMOVE THE DEFENDER
lesson.capturingDefender.goal: Take the piece that guards something, then win what it guarded.
lesson.deflection.title: DEFLECTION
lesson.deflection.goal: Pull a defender away from the job it's doing.
lesson.backRankMate.title: BACK RANK MATE
lesson.backRankMate.goal: The king is stuck behind its own pawns. Finish it on the back row.
lesson.skewer.title: SKEWERS
lesson.skewer.goal: Attack a big piece so it moves and leaves a smaller one behind.
lesson.xRayAttack.title: X-RAY
lesson.xRayAttack.goal: Attack straight through a piece to the one behind it.
lesson.mixed.title: EVERYTHING SO FAR
lesson.mixed.goal: Use every trick you've learned. Each puzzle is different!
lesson.oak: OAK: Before you battle, a quick lesson!
story.blue.meet: BLUE: Hey! Gramps said I could pick too. I'll take the one that beats yours. See you out there!
story.pewter-gym.1: BROCK: My defence is solid as rock. Can you keep your king safe while you attack?
story.cerulean-gym.1: MISTY: Trades are like tides. Make sure every one flows your way!
story.vermilion-gym.1: LT. SURGE: One strike, two targets! That's how we fight in Vermilion.
story.celadon-gym.1: ERIKA: Small things grow. A little pawn can bloom into a queen, you know.
story.fuchsia-gym.1: KOGA: Freeze your enemy in place. A pinned piece is a helpless piece.
story.saffron-gym.1: SABRINA: The real attacker is the one you can't see yet.
story.cinnabar-gym.1: BLAINE: Burn away the last defender and the king is wide open. Ready?
story.viridian-gym.1: GIOVANNI: So you have every badge but mine. Show me all of it at once.
line.gym-brock: BROCK: Your defence held. Take this badge, you've earned it.
line.gym-misty: MISTY: Every trade went your way. Fine, here's my badge!
line.gym-ltsurge: LT. SURGE: Two targets, every time! You fight like a soldier.
line.gym-erika: ERIKA: Your pawns blossomed beautifully. Please take this.
line.gym-koga: KOGA: You slipped out of every pin. Impressive, young one.
line.gym-sabrina: SABRINA: I saw this coming. I still couldn't stop it.
line.gym-blaine: BLAINE: Ha! You burned right through my defence!
line.gym-giovanni: GIOVANNI: ...You win. Take the badge. The LEAGUE awaits you.
badge.queen: Your first badge! The QUEEN slot in MY TEAM is open now.
story.mt-moon.1: A SUPER NERD guards two fossils in the dark. "Beat my puzzles and you can pick one!"
line.mm-gus: GUS: Okay, okay. Pick a fossil. I'll keep the other one.
story.power-plant.1: The lights flicker. Something huge crackles in the dark of the POWER PLANT.
line.legend-zapdos: ZAPDOS lets out a crackle and settles down beside you.
story.game-corner.1: ROCCO grins: "Win my puzzles and the prize behind the counter is yours."
line.gc-rocco: ROCCO: A deal's a deal. The prize is yours!
story.seafoam.1: An icy wind blows through the caves. A blue shape watches you from the ice.
line.legend-articuno: ARTICUNO folds its wings. It seems to trust you now.
story.cinnabar-lab.1: IRIS: I can bring this OLD AMBER back to life. Solve these first, so I know you'll look after it.
line.lab-iris: IRIS: It worked! Take good care of it.
story.victory-road.1: VICTORY ROAD: the last climb before the LEAGUE.
story.victory-road.2: OAK'S VOICE: Can you checkmate a lone king? Every champion can. Show me with a queen, then a rook.
drill.kq.title: QUEEN VS LONE KING
drill.kq.goal: Checkmate the lone king with your king and queen within {limit} moves. Careful: don't leave it without moves unless it's in check!
drill.kr.title: ROOK VS LONE KING
drill.kr.goal: Now with just a rook. Push the king to the edge and checkmate it within {limit} moves.
drill.why.draw: That was a draw (stalemate or too few pieces).
drill.why.lost: The game didn't end in checkmate.
drill.cleared: VICTORY ROAD cleared! The INDIGO PLATEAU is ahead.
story.moltres-peak.1: At the top of VICTORY ROAD, flames swirl around a giant bird.
line.legend-moltres: MOLTRES lowers its burning wings and joins you.
story.e4.1: INDIGO PLATEAU. Four trainers stand between you and the CHAMPION.
story.e4.2: Beat all four of the ELITE FOUR. Each one is harder than the last.
line.e4-lorelei: LORELEI: Your skewers cut right through my ice.
line.e4-bruno: BRUNO: You saw straight through my defence. Go on!
line.e4-agatha: AGATHA: Hmph. OAK chose well, it seems.
line.e4-lance: LANCE: You've beaten the ELITE FOUR. The CHAMPION is waiting.
story.champion.1: BLUE: Took you long enough! I'm the CHAMPION now, you know.
story.champion.2: BLUE: No puzzles this time. A real game, start to finish. Let's go!
champion.goal: Win a full game against BLUE. He plays at level {level}: {name}.
champion.title: THE CHAMPION
champion.lost: BLUE: Ha! Still second best. Come back when you're ready.
champion.won: BLUE: No way... I lost? ...You're the CHAMPION now.
hof.title: HALL OF FAME
hof.line: Congratulations, {name}! You and your team are now in the HALL OF FAME.
story.cerulean-cave.1: Deep in CERULEAN CAVE, something powerful is waiting. Only a CHAMPION may enter.
line.legend-mewtwo: MEWTWO stares at you for a long time. Then it decides to come along.
reward.starter: OAK: Here's a partner for you too. {name} wanted to come along!
mew.line: OAK: 150 Pokémon! Wait... something tiny is floating over your shoulder. MEW wants to join you!
trade.evolved: Your {from} evolved into {to} after the online win!
lesson.pewter-gym.title: BROCK'S ROCK SOLID TEST
lesson.pewter-gym.goal: Keep your king safe and don't leave pieces hanging.
lesson.cerulean-gym.title: MISTY'S TIDE OF TRADES
lesson.cerulean-gym.goal: Only trade when you come out ahead.
lesson.vermilion-gym.title: LT. SURGE'S DOUBLE STRIKE
lesson.vermilion-gym.goal: Find forks: one move, two targets.
lesson.celadon-gym.title: ERIKA'S GARDEN
lesson.celadon-gym.goal: Help a pawn grow all the way into a queen.
lesson.fuchsia-gym.title: KOGA'S PARALYSIS
lesson.fuchsia-gym.goal: Pin a piece so it can't move.
lesson.saffron-gym.title: SABRINA'S HIDDEN ATTACK
lesson.saffron-gym.goal: Uncover the attacker hiding behind your own piece.
lesson.cinnabar-gym.title: BLAINE'S FIRE
lesson.cinnabar-gym.goal: Burn away the last defender, then finish the king.
lesson.viridian-gym.title: GIOVANNI'S BOSS EXAM
lesson.viridian-gym.goal: Everything from all eight gyms, all mixed up.
lesson.mt-moon.title: THE FOSSIL TEST
lesson.power-plant.title: ZAPDOS'S STORM
lesson.power-plant.goal: Strike two things at once, or check with two pieces.
lesson.game-corner.title: THE PRIZE TABLE
lesson.game-corner.goal: Find the move that wins the most.
lesson.seafoam.title: ARTICUNO'S ICE
lesson.seafoam.goal: Freeze pieces with pins and skewers.
lesson.cinnabar-lab.title: THE AMBER TEST
lesson.cinnabar-lab.goal: Push your pawns all the way.
lesson.moltres-peak.title: MOLTRES'S FLAME
lesson.moltres-peak.goal: Finish the king fast: mate in 2 and back rank.
lesson.e4-lorelei.title: LORELEI'S ICE LANCE
lesson.e4-lorelei.goal: Attack the big piece so the one behind it falls.
lesson.e4-bruno.title: BRUNO'S X-RAY
lesson.e4-bruno.goal: See through a piece to the target behind it.
lesson.e4-agatha.title: AGATHA'S TRICKS
lesson.e4-agatha.goal: Anything goes, and the puzzles get harder.
lesson.e4-lance.title: LANCE'S DRAGON TRIAL
lesson.cerulean-cave.title: MEWTWO'S MIND
lesson.cerulean-cave.goal: The hardest puzzles of all. Every one counts.

review.hanging: That {piece} had no defender. Free to take!
review.promotion: Your pawn made it all the way and became a {piece}!
review.solved: Solved! That was the strongest line.
review.wrong.over: That move ends the game the wrong way.

manual.title: INSTRUCTION BOOKLET
manual.journey.title: Kanto Journey
manual.journey.1: Walk from Pallet Town to the Champion, one place at a time.
manual.journey.2: Trainers and gym leaders battle you with puzzles: solve enough to win.
manual.journey.3: After each puzzle, look at the review, then tap Continue.
manual.training.title: Training
manual.training.1: Every theme from a route you've visited is here.
manual.training.2: Tap Lesson to see Oak's example again.
manual.training.3: Solving still moves your Trainer Level.
manual.battle.title: Battle!
manual.battle.1: One tap starts a game the way you played last.
manual.battle.2: Real chess rules: every capture plays a little battle.
manual.battle.3: Checkmate the other trainer's king to win.
manual.computer.title: vs Computer
manual.computer.1: Choose TEAM RED or TEAM ROCKET.
manual.computer.2: Youngster is gentle, Champion almost never loses.
manual.computer.3: Take back is allowed at the first two levels.
manual.two.title: Two Players
manual.two.1: Two people, one screen: take turns.
manual.two.3: Settings can flip the board after each move.
manual.online.title: Online
manual.online.1: Make a room and share its 4 letter code or the link.
manual.online.2: Send one of six reactions, never typed chat.
manual.online.3: If someone drops out, they have 60 seconds to come back.
manual.pieces.title: Your Pieces
manual.pieces.1: Every piece is a Pokémon, and it moves like its chess piece.
manual.pieces.2: The small symbol in the corner tells you which piece it is.
manual.pieces.3: My Team lets you swap in the Pokémon you caught.
manual.catching.title: Battles & Catching
manual.catching.1: A capture plays a battle with the attacker's own move.
manual.catching.2: Solve a tall grass puzzle and a wild Pokémon appears.
manual.catching.3: Solve on the first try for the best chance to catch it.
